About AutoStacc

A store and a library in one. Projects make music, sounds and visuals; AutoStacc sells them, delivers them and keeps everything you own organized. Stacc it once. Auto handles the rest.

How it works

  1. 01A project createsMusic, samples, MIDI, presets, stems and visuals, under its own name and style.
  2. 02AutoStacc catalogs and sells itEvery product says who made it. Checkout runs on Stripe; this site never sees your card.
  3. 03It lands in Your StaccSorted by project, Stacclet, Pac and content type, so the MIDI you want is one click away.
  4. 04Auto handles the restFollow a project and switch on Auto-Stacc: its free releases arrive by themselves. Paid ones show up as new, never as owned.

The words

Your Stacc
Your library: everything you've collected, from every project.
Stacclet
A collection of related Pacs from one project.
Pac
A folder of content: MIDI, samples, loops, presets and more. Download one file, a selection or the lot.
Auto-Stacc
Automatically add a followed project's eligible free content.
